name: Pylon
description: Pylon is a B2B support platform with an API to read and write issues, accounts and contacts.
auth_notes: Admin-generated API token authenticates requests; sources do not say how it is sent in headers.
gate_detail: Only Admin users can create API tokens, so a Pylon workspace with an admin is needed. Sources do not state which plan includes API access or whether a free signup or sandbox exists.
api_scope: Read and write access to accounts, contacts, issues, messages, tasks and projects, knowledge base, custom fields, custom objects, tags, macros, teams, surveys and users; TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs plus experimental CLI.
mcp_notes: Docs navigation lists a Pylon MCP page, but no provided source describes it or gives a URL.
blocker_detail: API token creation is restricted to Admin users; plan requirements and signup path are not stated in sources.

evidence.quote: As an Admin, generate an API token in Pylon to authenticate your requests.
Only Admin users can create API tokens.
To call the API from TypeScript, Python, or Go, use our SDKs
Webhooks fire on specific events inside Pylon and post to an endpoint you control
Pylon’s API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.

issues: How the token is sent (header scheme) is not stated.
Plan or pricing requirements for API access are not stated.
MCP server content is not in the sources.
S4-S6 describe different products and were ignored.
